seeker_flawed_plan: Jolie plans to get regular nail polish because she believes a fresh topcoat reapplied every day or two will make it last through a weekend of scrubbing and gardening just as well as gel.

seeker_flawed_plan: Nina plans to fix the glare in the surgical training video by simply turning down the overall exposure in post-processing, assuming that darkening the whole frame will bring the bright reflections on the instruments and tissue down to a comfortable level.

seeker_flawed_plan: Selah plans to choose quartersawn oak for the sliding lid so that the flat-sawn face of the lid will stay dimensionally stable across its width and slide smoothly regardless of seasonal humidity changes.
flaw_explanation: Quartersawn lumber is stable across its width, but a sliding lid's critical movement is along the grain direction (length), where all wood species expand and contract very little anyway; the lid's fit is governed by the cross-grain width of the box opening, not the lid's face orientation, so choosing quartersawn stock for the lid does not solve the seasonal binding Selah is worried about.
